claims.claim: Nov 3 is the anniversary of the first Brooklyn game (Nov 3, 2012)

sources.title: Nets open Barclays in style, defeat Raptors in home debut

claims.evidence: The Nets beat Toronto 107-100 at Barclays Center on Nov 3, 2012, their first regular-season game there. The Nov 1 opener against the Knicks was pushed back after Hurricane Sandy.

claims.claim: The franchise's only titles were the 1974 and 1976 ABA championships, led by Julius Erving, won by a team that never played in Brooklyn

sources.title: They Had a Ball: The New York Nets' 1974 Championship Run

claims.evidence: The New York Nets clinched the 1974 title against the Utah Stars on May 10, 1974, and the 1976 title against Denver on May 13, 1976, both at home on Long Island (Nassau Coliseum). Erving was playoff MVP both years.

claims.claim: caribBEING, led by Shelley Worrell, is a Little Caribbean cultural organization that can run listening sessions and a heritage night

sources.title: Shelley Worrell Champions NYC’s Caribbean Community

claims.evidence: Worrell founded caribBEING, a Flatbush group that runs events, tours and public programs and partners with public and private groups. She led the Little Caribbean designation, and the area won awards in 2024. No result was dated 2026, so its current programs and interest in a paid Nets project are still unconfirmed.
